APPROVE
The three helpers keep the original control flow (including the per-directory `maxFiles` break, still enqueuing subdirectories afterwards, and recording the same `Unread` entries), so behaviour is unchanged, and `Files` drops to roughly 4 cognitive complexity; the `CHA0004` suppression still covers every catch, so it should build, though I couldn't confirm that `wanted` and `files` match the `Func<string, bool>` and tuple-list types the helpers declare, since the original signature isn't shown.
